text: Zoe's driving test is on 14 November at the Wembley centre. Her second attempt, and she's quietly terrified about the roundabouts. Text her good luck the night before.
Matteo turns 30 on June 3rd. He's been getting really into espresso, so a decent hand grinder might be a winner.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and drop the parcel at the post office on the way.
Florin passed his theory test this morning! First go, too.

Yara mentioned her audition for the conservatory is 12/02. Cello, Elgar concerto. She said she hasn't slept properly in a week. Her teacher thinks she's ready, but Yara keeps changing her mind about the cadenza. The results come out in the first week of January, which feels like forever away. I should drop her a message on the day of the audition, nothing heavy, just that I'm thinking of her.
Note to self: renew passport by 5/14 at the latest. The Lisbon trip is booked for June 9th and I am not paying for fast track again.

Anya's daughter Giulia gets her A level results on 13th of August. Anya is far more nervous than Giulia is. Giulia needs an A in chemistry for the vet course at Liverpool, and she already has a backup offer from Nottingham. Anya says she's planning to take the whole day off and hover. Worth a message to both of them on the 13th.
Lunch with Adriana. She's training to be a dental hygienist and finishes her placement in March. Loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli.
Need to order Mehmet's birthday present by Friday. His birthday is 2 December and he keeps dropping hints about the new Lego Botanical set.
Nadia's cat Pistachio had his teeth out yesterday. She sounded exhausted on the phone. Check in with her over the weekend.
Ayo and his wife Sadia are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 21/11. They're going back to Zanzibar for a week.
Rory failed his driving test again, third time. Gutted, understandably. He's rebooked for January 8th.
Must remember: Katarzyna's viva is on 4 December. She said she'd rather nobody asked about it until afterwards, so message her on the 5th to see how it went.

Bridget is vegan now, and very serious about it. Worth knowing for her birthday dinner on 17th March. She's booked the new place on Castle Street, and her partner Gintaras is sorting the cake, which has to be vegan and gluten free because of his coeliac thing. She's asked everyone to avoid buying her stuff this year and donate to the donkey sanctuary instead.

Anjali's son is sitting his eleven plus on September 14th. She's been tutoring him every evening and looks worn out. The mock was on 3 June and he scored well, but she's convinced the real one will be harder. Her husband thinks they're overdoing it. I said I'd lend her the practice papers my sister used, so dig those out of the loft this weekend.
Gym at 7, then the big shop. Book the car in for its MOT before 30/10.
Bruno said Ilse wants a record player for her birthday. Her birthday is the 9th of February, so plenty of time. Maybe chip in with Bruno.
Kenji got into the youth orchestra! Audition was last Tuesday and they told him today.
Called Gintaras about the flat. He's moving to Vilnius in the spring and wants to sell the bike before he goes.
Lior's grade 8 piano exam was cancelled because the examiner was ill. It's been moved to 3/22 instead. Ask him how he's feeling about the wait.
Abigail's little brother Rory starts his GCSE mocks next week. She says he's barely opened a book.
Bogdan and Divya's engagement party was supposed to be 8 November but they've called it off. Not the engagement, just the party, because Divya's dad is in hospital. I should send Divya a card.
Milan collects vintage football shirts. Specifically Red Star Belgrade, anything pre-2000.
Barbara's 70th is on 19 April. Her daughter Moira is organising a surprise lunch at the Italian place on Hill Street. I'm doing the cake, already agreed.

Amy is struggling with her nursing exams. She said the pharmacology module is the worst and she's thinking about resitting in the summer. Her placement on the cardiac ward has been brutal too, twelve-hour shifts and a mentor who barely speaks to her. Her exam is 19 November, and if she resits it'll be some time in July. She said she just wants it to be over. Take her out for dinner after the 19th, whatever happens.
Lorenzo's results day is August 15th. He needs AAB for Bristol. Remind me to text him that morning.
Fatima's birthday: 11/06, as in 11th of June. She loves anything lavender and has been eyeing up a fancy bath set from Neal's Yard.
Jaya has her citizenship test on October 28th. She keeps saying it's fine, but she's asked me to quiz her twice already.
Dentist moved to 2 November, 9:15. Cancel the Pilates class that morning.
Zoe Lopez, or Zo as everyone calls her, has finally booked her motorbike test for May 14. Don't forget to ask her how the lessons are going before then.
Matteo's mum has her hip operation on 6th of December. He's taking the week off to look after her.
Coffee with Yara and Anya. Yara has a recital on 1 March and Anya's starting a new job at the library on 3/3. Busy week for them both.
Florin's sister Adriana passed her bar exams! Florin was beaming. Send her a congratulations card.
Giulia said her dog Biscotto is turning one on 22nd of January. She's planning a little party for him, which is very Giulia.
Mehmet got his IELTS result back: 8.5 overall. That was the last thing he needed for the visa.
Remember to buy wrapping paper, batteries, and a birthday card for Nadia. Her birthday's on 7/12 and the party is the Saturday after.
Ayo has an audition for the National Youth Theatre on 25 February. He's preparing a monologue from Othello and says his nerves are shot. Wish him luck on the day.
Sadia is allergic to tree nuts. Keep in mind for the dinner.
Rory's dad, Uncle Bruno, retires on 31st of March after forty years at the council. Rory says there's a do at the cricket club the following weekend.

Long chat with Katarzyna Nowak tonight. Her PhD funding runs out in January, her landlord is selling the flat, and her mum is coming over from Kraków for Christmas. She's applying for a postdoc in Edinburgh with an interview on 9 December. She sounded calm about the interview but properly stressed about finding somewhere to live. I should send her the link to the letting agent I used.
Bridget asked if I could help her revise for her driving theory on 4/17. Told her I'm free most evenings that week.
Anjali's husband Kenji gets his black belt grading on 16 November. She's bringing the kids to watch. He's been training for three years.
Book eye test. Return the library books before 1/11 or I'll get fined again.
Ilse's birthday dinner went really well on Saturday. She loved the earrings. Need to get Bruno back for his half of the present.
Gintaras said his partner Lior is sitting the CFA Level 2 exam on 24 May. Lior's been studying since January and has basically vanished from social life. Must check in on Lior after the exam.
Abigail got her grade 5 ballet distinction! The exam was on 2 October and the results came through this week.
Bogdan likes craft beer, Japanese whisky, and terrible puns. His birthday is 28th of July.
Divya's mum, Mrs Gupta, has her cataract surgery on November 3rd. Divya is driving her there and back.
Milan's driving test is 15/01 at half eight. He hasn't had a lesson since the summer and is panicking. Remind me to call Milan a couple of days before to offer a practice drive.
Barbara asked what Moira might like for her graduation on July 10th. Moira mentioned wanting a good fountain pen, a Lamy maybe.
Amy's brother Lorenzo starts his apprenticeship with the electricians on January 6th. She says he's really excited about it.
Fatima Yilmaz, the new neighbour at number 14, works nights at the hospital. Two kids, a rescue greyhound called Tess.

Jaya passed her citizenship test! She texted at lunchtime. Ceremony should be sometime in December. She'd been revising for weeks, mostly the history bits, and was convinced she'd mixed up the dates of the Magna Carta. Her husband is taking her out to celebrate on Friday. Don't forget to get her a card, and ask when the ceremony is so I can try to go.
Today: finish the tax return, transfer rent, and order Mum's flowers for the 25th. Everything else can wait until next week.
Zoe mentioned that Matteo's sister Nadia has a scholarship interview at St Andrews on 12 January, followed by an entrance exam the next morning. Nadia is apparently very calm. Matteo, not so much.

Florin and Yara are flying to Bucharest on 18th of December for his grandad's 90th, back on January 2nd. He wants something for his grandad from here, maybe a good Scotch. Yara is a bit anxious because it's her first time meeting his whole family, and apparently his aunt is formidable. They're also squeezing in a trip to Sibiu for a couple of days after Christmas. I said I'd water their plants while they're away, so get the spare key off Florin before the 18th.
Sadia's son failed his maths retake. She's upset, he's more upset. Ask her next week how he's doing.
Adriana said her brother Bruno's birthday was last week and nobody remembered except her. Feel bad. I need to message Bruno and apologise, maybe take him out for a pint.
Get the car washed and fill up before the drive to Leeds on Saturday.

Kenji's mum, Dr Moira Walsh, is giving a keynote at the Royal Society on 5/20. He's so proud of her. Mostly she just likes gardening and crosswords, apparently. Her birthday is 2nd of June and Kenji wants to get her something thoughtful rather than another scarf. I suggested a first edition of a gardening book or a subscription to the Guardian cryptic book series. He's also mentioned she's been nervous about the keynote, which surprised me.
